question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is "**in with**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In blank 4 the correct phrase will be "in with."
 
• In the given passage, the phrase should be "blend in with."
 
• **When we complete the phrase, the phrase "blend in with" will mean to look or seem the same as surrounding people or things and therefore not be easily noticeable.**
 
 
• Example: They have adopted local customs and tried to blend in with the community.
 
 
 
• The correct preposition to use with "fill in blank number 4" is "in with".
 
• "In" and "at with" are incorrect prepositions to use in this context. 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 4**.
